ideas.title: Minnesota Fraud Coverup
ideas.description: Investigate allegations of a coverup by the Walz administration
ideas.angle: Follow the money and investigate whistleblower claims
questions: What did the Walz administration know about the fraud?
ideas.insight: The Minnesota fraud investigation has uncovered evidence of a possible coverup by the Walz administration, including allegations that whistleblowers were threatened with drastic military measures.
